newsitem.title: UK: Circle Communications cautious on '97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Circle Communications cautious on '97 profit.

text.p: British television rights company Circle Communications Plc, set to be bought by Australia's Southern Star Group, said on Wednesday it was cautious about its prospects this year.
Circle, which focuses on television rights for drama and wildlife, said pressure on margins and delayed availability of some programmes had continued into this year from the second half of 1996.
"The board is therefore cautious about prospects for profitability in the current year," the firm said in a statement released here.
Circle agreed to be taken over by Southern Star in a deal that valued it at 9.8 million stg, or 75p per share in cash.
Circle's shares were marked up 7.5p at 75 by 0900 GMT.
Circle reported a pretax profit of 713,000 stg on turnover of 8.1 million stg for the year to December 31. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
